newsitem.title: USA: Dow Jones family member resigns post.
newsitem.headline: Dow Jones family member resigns post.

text.p: William Cox III, a member of the family that controls Dow Jones & Co Inc, has resigned from his job at the media company, a Dow Jones spokesman said Friday.

Spokesman Sanford Jacobs said the company received a letter from Cox saying he was leaving the company where he had worked for 18 years. Most recently, he was managing Dow Jones' global stock indexes, Jacobs said.

Cox, whose father William Cox Jr is on the board of directors, did not immediately return two telephone calls seeking comment. His lawyer, Ira Millstein, also has not returned several telephone calls over the past week.
Cox and a cousin, Elisabeth Goth, have made headlines in recent weeks over their stated disappointment with the company's direction and the value of its stock.
Other family members, including Cox's father, have said they support Dow Jones management.
